functions.name: cpalgorithms::sum
functions.signature: inline long long cpalgorithms::sum(const std::vector<int>& v)
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of all elements in the given std::vector<int>, accumulating into a 64-bit signed integer. Typical use: pass any constructed vector of ints; the function iterates once over the elements and returns 0 for an empty vector. Note: the accumulation type is long long; extremely large totals could overflow long long.
requirements: v must be a valid, initialized reference to a std::vector<int>.
Elements of v are of type int; no additional constraints on value range beyond int representability.

Function performs no allocation or I/O and throws no exceptions under normal operation; callers should not expect error signaling other than potential integer overflow if the mathematical sum exceeds the range of long long.

functions.name: cpalgorithms::banner
functions.description: Returns a fixed, human-readable banner string identifying the library ("cp-algorithms example lib"). Intended for display or diagnostics; no inputs required.
requirements: No preconditions; may be called at any time.
Returns a std::string by value; caller may use or store the returned string normally.
